item.statement: The valid input family consists of positive width and height, pitch at least width, arbitrary i32 shiftX/shiftY, and a readable logical source region; the candidate must accept every member of this family without changing floor-mod semantics.

plans.objective: Confirm the candidate interface accepts the full admitted valid input family and does not impose unadmitted restrictions.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact (kernel plus host wrapper) and read the argument declarations and validation code.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate accepts positive width/height with pitch>=width and i32 shifts, and any additional restriction is explicitly documented as outside the admitted domain rather than silently rejected.
plans.setup: Inspect the future Ascend-C candidate signature, parameter types, domain guards, and launch geometry derivation.
